title: The van der Waerden Simplicial Complex and its Lefschetz Properties
summary: The van der Waerden simplicial complex, denoted ${\tt vdw}(n,k)$, is the simpicial complex whose facets correspond to the arithmetic progressions of length $k$ in the set $\{1,\ldots,n\}$. We study the Lefschetz properties of the Artinian ring $A({\tt vdw}(n,k)) = K[x_1,\ldots,x_n]/(I_{{\tt vdw}(n,k)} + \langle x_1^2,\ldots,x_n^2\rangle)$ where $I_{{\tt vdw}(n,k)}$ is the associated Stanley--Reisner ideal.
